title: Woman With No License Causes The Most Brutal Accident And Tries To Deny It
description:
#news #police #arrest

FULL VIDEO: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y0XFkVhT8Ks

On April 1st, 2022. Officers responded to the scene of an accident in which a car travelling at a high-speed rate hit another car crossing the street at a 4-point stop intersection. The victim's car was completely totalled. When the officer located the suspect, she tried to act like someone hit her car and they found out she did not have a driver's license.
